context: The eval checks whether the scale and resilience lens catches a batch-processing regression introduced by replacing one bulk remote call with a remote call per row.

checklist.name: Finds the N+1 remote call regression
checklist.description: States that the new code calls users.get once per audit row instead of using getMany once per unique actorId

checklist.name: Quantifies the scale trigger
checklist.description: Connects the issue to large workspaces and the 20,000-row export size, not only to a theoretical performance concern

checklist.name: Explains the failure mode
checklist.description: Mentions likely timeout, rate-limit, overload, or partial dependency failure from thousands of remote calls

checklist.name: Gives the concrete fix
checklist.description: Proposes restoring the batched getMany path, caching by actorId, or another bounded bulk lookup

checklist.name: Avoids cold-path nitpicks
checklist.description: Keeps the finding focused on the request path and does not spend the answer on small style or micro-optimization complaints
